leadText:
An unnamed island in the Orange Islands appears in A Way Off Day Off. It is presumably the deserted island located between Murcott Island and Mandarin Island South shown on the map in Extreme Pokémon: The Guide for the Ultimate Fan.

It features several small waterfalls that empty into a basin, which later flows into a running creek and eventually a crescent-shaped bay. This island is uninhabited, and is home to many different fruit trees. Many live on this island, and it is hinted that they migrate here once a year.
